location_description: Pontiac ( POHN-tee-ack) is a city in and the county seat of Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan.  As of the 2020 census, the city had a total population of 61,606.  A northern suburb of Metro Detroit, Pontiac is about 20 miles (32.2 km) northwest of Detroit.
